description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Azure deployment-based queue balancers in Orleans silo persistent stream configurations. It provides methods to set up dynamic and static Azure deployment load balancing strategies based on Azure deployment info and silo statuses.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure Azure deployment-based queue balancers for Orleans silo persistent streams.

methods.name: UseDynamicAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream queue balancer to use Azure deployment info and membership oracle for load balancing, with an optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseStaticAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream queue balancer to use Azure deployment info without membership oracle data, for static load balancing, with an optional silo maturity period.
